objective: Modernize IGPAT / shared Reel comments on native and web with a compact, avatar-led conversation and send bar; repair literal Prayer Request mojibake without broad navigation, database or monetization changes.
productionBaselineEvidence: The patch branch was created from the Nov11 consolidated DEV source hold SHA 07a3be5e1b66857197a0a36c65c6933c39e8273c; GitHub PR compare was ahead by 5 commits/behind by zero before scope manifest. The consolidated source and GitHub main remain diverged. Physical-device pixels, exact OTA runtime and live production promotion have not been verified.
chosenApproach: Update the existing PostDetail path shared by IGPAT, Wall and Reel deep links rather than duplicate comment data code; move comments to compact avatar/bubble rows with a persistent small composer, preserve authenticated RPCs/replies/mentions/moderation and ad cadence, and deep-link native/web IGPAT comment actions to the rendered comment section. Replace only the double-encoded literal Prayer detail labels.
selectionRationale: One canonical detail view keeps reply/report/privacy logic centralized, avoids a new native module or extra client network flow, and delivers direct IGPAT comment focus on both platforms. Retains older post links and restores properly readable Prayer labels.
alternativeApproaches: Build a separate full IGPAT modal/comment backend: rejected as it duplicates the existing post comments RPC, privacy checks and moderation wiring.
Only change font sizes or re-encode runtime network text: rejected because the source contains literal mojibake and the full-screen form remains visually outdated.
Refactor every Wall/Marites/Scoped comment implementation at once: rejected to limit regression and preserve existing featured views.
preserveBehaviors: Post detail reaction counts, reactions, reply parent IDs, mentions, report and author actions remain available.
Per-comment ad cadence and sponsored placement stay wired without adding ad overlay to the comment send form.
IGPAT native/web video playback, no-zoom frame fit, scroll prefetch and data saver remain untouched.
Prayer responder counting/names, visibility, idempotent 'I PRAYED', status updates and moderation report route unchanged.
Current Expo runtime, native libraries, production OTA and database remain untouched.
Existing author-only post visibility and deep-link scoping remain server enforced.
acceptanceChecks: IGPAT Android and web Comments actions open post detail directly at comment section, with still-working old /post/<id> links.
Comments render compact rows with avatar/name/message/time, reply and report actions, focus comment highlight.
Empty thread shows small state; composer stays small, expands up to four lines, and blocks blank/double submits.
On successful comment existing server RPC, reply parent and ad cadence run, preserving typed draft on server error.
Prayer disclosure arrows, report button and answered state display correctly encoded text.
Focused regression tests and engineering scope gate pass on exact patch SHA; TypeScript and Android/web release export remain mandatory for RC.
Do not publish production OTA or claim device verification based on PR checks.
